data.content_ref: inline:The registry-confounding account in SRC_005 abstracts SRC_003's one-repository arbitrariness claim by specifying the causal mechanism through which arbitrary installation history generates the 3-of-26 distribution: the registry's enumeration semantics are defined by the test's own installation history, so the test constrains only entries installed under a detectable guard. Refuted if the 3 surviving mutations are re-run under ordinary installation order and are not caught, or if the registry has deterministic enumeration order and the survivors do not cluster in a way consistent with installation-history-defined semantics.
